method.rule: A normal-walk path only proves one traversable line under its declared movement policy. It does not by itself prove clear width, uniform stair geometry, landing depth, live door operation, separated egress, or an accessible alternative.

findings.finding: The current 22-route checker uses two-block headroom and does not measure a continuous clear-width envelope or landing depth. It cannot certify that a public corridor is not one block wide.
findings.affected: All 22 declared R08AM-bound Town Expansion routes; especially routes labelled public, public-vehicle-and-pedestrian-observation, worker-public, and citizen.

findings.finding: The C01 mountain-portal to L1 route fails both offline directions: no bounded normal-walk path was found.
The MainStreet surface vehicle portal to dry warehouse hall route fails both offline directions: no bounded normal-walk path was found.
The Observatory hidden entry to inactive portal-gallery ring route fails both offline directions. It remains owner-only and must not be shown as an available connection.

Empty Eight has bounded internal public exploration only. Its eleven south bays and two PF08 stairs do not have released exterior discharge, accessible route, or commissioned emergency egress. BOH and the lower annex are restricted, not public routes.
Cheyenne B03 is a 613-station passive internal inspection route with the index-800 chamber cap closed and indices 0..187 held. It has no public, secure, exterior, or emergency-route acceptance.

An earlier citizen-commute repair recorded four narrow cells, including one one-block-wide cell. That evidence is bound to a superseded July snapshot and cannot establish current geometry, but it is a mandatory first-survey target before citizen-route activation.

singleBlockStairConclusion: No current accepted source claims a one-block-wide stair as a primary public, owner, staff, or B03 route. The audit cannot certify the absence of single-width pinch points across all existing paths until CIRC-QA-CORE-01 runs on a fresh snapshot. The historical citizen-commute one-block narrow point must be re-surveyed before activation.
